info.name: API4 - FR-13 Admin Dashboard (GET /api/admin/orders) [CI gate]
info.description:
HW06 / Pool C / FR-13 - Admin dashboard.

The dashboard has no endpoint of its own: total revenue (the sum of total_amount over orders with status='delivered') and the total order count are both derived from GET /api/admin/orders, so that endpoint is the API under test.

Generated from scripts/cases/api4_fr13_admin_orders.py. The revenue rule makes the aggregate a projection of the FR-10 state machine, so the state folder drives orders into each status and checks whether the figure moves when - and only when - it should. FR-12 / SEC-03 access control is exercised with genuine, forged and tampered tokens.

Escalation cases deliberately use LEGAL transitions, so that a refusal can only mean authorisation was checked.

---

CI REGRESSION GATE - generated, do not edit.

Contains the 68 of 78 cases that passed the run recorded in reports/API4_FR13_AdminOrders.json. The remaining 10 fail because the SUT violates the specification; they are tracked in docs/bugs/BUG_REPORT.md, not here. Refresh with:

    python scripts/render-cases.py --api 4 --refresh-gate
